title: Load a supported music folder and populate the sidebar library
description: User opens a local folder with supported audio files and the app populates the sidebar/library with parsed track metadata.

steps.description: Navigate to /player
Open a local folder containing supported audio files
Grant the browser permission to read the selected directory
Verify the song list is populated in the sidebar/library

title: Start playback and control play/pause, seek, and volume
description: User plays a selected track and can pause/resume, seek to a new position, and change volume while playback continues with playhead progress updating.

steps.description: Navigate to /player
Open a local folder containing supported audio files
Grant the browser permission to read the selected directory
Select a track from the library
Start playback
Seek to a new position in the track
Adjust the volume to a different level
Toggle playback to pause
Verify playback is paused and the playhead position reflects the seeked location

title: Skip to next track and return to previous track during playback
description: User advances to the next track and returns to the previous track while playback remains functional and the current track changes accordingly.

steps.description: Navigate to /player
Open a local folder containing supported audio files
Grant the browser permission to read the selected directory
Select a track from the library
Start playback
Advance to the next track
Return to the previous track
Verify the currently playing track updates when using next and previous controls

title: Lyrics stay highlighted in sync during playback and after seeking
description: Verifies that synced lyrics load for a playing track and the current line highlight remains in sync after the user seeks mid-song.

steps.description: Navigate to /player
Open a local music folder using the folder picker
Select a track from the library
Start playback
Open the lyrics panel
Seek to a later point in the track
Verify the current lyric line is highlighted and updates over time during playback
Verify the highlighted lyric line changes appropriately after seeking

title: Visualizer animates in real time during playback
description: User starts playback and the visualizer bars respond in real time to the audio output.

steps.description: Navigate to /player
Open a local folder containing supported audio files
Grant the browser permission to read the selected directory
Select a track from the library
Start playback
Verify the visualizer is animating and reacting to the audio during playback

title: Embedded artwork displays automatically when available
description: Verifies that selecting a track with embedded artwork shows album art immediately for that track.

steps.description: Navigate to /player
Open a local music folder using the folder picker
Select a track from the library that has embedded artwork
Verify album artwork is displayed for the selected track
Verify the artwork is not a generic placeholder

title: Artwork resolves for tracks without embedded art
description: Verifies that selecting a track without embedded art results in artwork being displayed after resolution completes.

steps.description: Navigate to /player
Open a local music folder using the folder picker
Select a track from the library that does not contain embedded artwork
Wait for the artwork area to update
Verify album artwork is displayed for the selected track
Verify the displayed artwork corresponds to the current track selection rather than a previously selected track

title: Artwork updates correctly when switching tracks quickly
description: Verifies that rapid track changes do not cause artwork from a previous track to remain visible for the current selection.

steps.description: Navigate to /player
Open a local music folder using the folder picker
Select a track from the library
Quickly select a different track from the library
Quickly select another different track from the library
Wait for the artwork area to settle
Verify the displayed artwork corresponds to the currently selected track
Verify the artwork does not revert to a previous track after it updates

title: Lyrics update to match the newly selected track during rapid switching
description: Verifies that switching tracks quickly results in the lyrics panel showing lyrics for the current track only and not a previous selection.

steps.description: Navigate to /player
Open a local music folder using the folder picker
Select a track from the library
Start playback
Open the lyrics panel
Quickly select a different track from the library
Quickly select another different track from the library
Verify the lyrics panel content corresponds to the currently selected track
Verify the highlighted lyric line updates over time for the current track

title: Artwork remains consistent through play/pause and track navigation
description: Verifies that using play/pause and next/previous track controls keeps the artwork in sync with the currently selected track.

steps.description: Navigate to /player
Open a local music folder using the folder picker
Select a track from the library
Start playback
Pause playback
Resume playback
Skip to the next track
Skip to the previous track
Verify the displayed artwork matches the currently selected track after navigation
Verify the artwork area displays a single resolved image rather than multiple competing states

title: Lyrics panel remains stable when switching between playback controls
description: Verifies that using pause/resume and next/previous track controls does not leave the lyrics panel in an inconsistent state.

steps.description: Navigate to /player
Open a local music folder using the folder picker
Select a track from the library
Start playback
Open the lyrics panel
Pause playback
Resume playback
Skip to the next track
Verify the lyrics panel shows lyrics or a no-lyrics state for the currently playing track
Verify the current lyric highlight updates when playback is running

title: Adjust 5-band EQ and apply a preset without breaking playback
description: User opens the EQ panel, changes multiple frequency bands and applies a preset, and playback continues without interruption while the EQ state updates.

steps.description: Navigate to /player
Open a local folder containing supported audio files
Grant the browser permission to read the selected directory
Select a track from the library
Start playback
Open the EQ panel
Move a low-frequency band slider to a different position
Move a high-frequency band slider to a different position
Select an EQ preset
Verify playback continues and the EQ panel reflects the applied adjustments/preset

title: User can manually scroll lyrics without breaking playback state
description: Verifies that the user can scroll the lyrics view to inspect surrounding lines while playback continues normally.

steps.description: Navigate to /player
Open a local music folder using the folder picker
Select a track from the library
Start playback
Open the lyrics panel
Scroll the lyrics list to a different section
Verify playback is still running
Verify the lyrics panel remains usable and displays lyric lines

title: AI poster fallback shows when no artwork sources are available
description: Verifies that when embedded and other artwork sources are not available for a track, a poster-style fallback image is displayed.

steps.description: Navigate to /player
Open a local music folder using the folder picker
Select a track from the library that results in no embedded artwork being available
Wait for artwork resolution to complete
Verify a fallback poster-style artwork is displayed for the selected track
Verify the fallback artwork is not the same as the previously displayed track artwork

title: Clear empty state when synced lyrics are unavailable
description: Verifies that when a track has no synced lyrics available, the lyrics panel shows a clear not-found state rather than stale or mismatched lyrics.

steps.description: Navigate to /player
Open a local music folder using the folder picker
Select a track from the library
Start playback
Open the lyrics panel
Select a different track from the library that results in no synced lyrics being available
Verify a clear no-lyrics-available state is shown in the lyrics panel
Verify lyrics from the previously selected track are not shown

title: Handle a folder with no playable audio files
description: User opens a local folder with no supported audio files and the app shows an empty-library state indicating no playable files were found.

steps.description: Navigate to /player
Open a local folder containing no supported audio files
Verify an empty-library state is displayed indicating no playable files were found
